John Henry Budd, M.D. was born in Canada on December 6, 1908. A lifelong jazz enthusiast, music has always been his avocation. During his high school years he was employed playing the piano for a year in movie theaters, prior to the “talkies.” He has enjoyed a distinguished medical career, and is a former president of the AMA. Dr. Budd has enjoyed many friendships with jazz musicians throughout the years, and continues to attend jazz parties across the country.
Dr. Budd was interviewed at the Jerome Jazz Party in Aspen, Colorado on October 11, 1997, by Monk Rowe, director of the Hamilton College Jazz Archive.
